assertions.source: Delta tr_conn^plain has exact [hbar_q^4]=16/3 and [hbar_q^8]=107, and alpha_EM(q_2t)^2*hbar_q^4 / u^4 = 0.9752367663

description: First-principles exact Q[[hbar_q]] / Q(sqrt(3))[[hbar_q]] derivation and 80-dps evaluation of the fourth-order Habiro / Kashiwara / Wedderburn ladder rung c_4 (bean qou-51yf, u^4 ~ 5.263e-9): rationality of all even rungs u^{2m}(q) in Q(q), Contribution A (Habiro 4th cyclotomic Pochhammer norm, m=2 Kashiwara divided-power cosine [2]_q/([3]_q[4]_q) -> +1/6, Chebyshev C_KD^(6) cubic in h^2), Contribution B (Convention-D & GPMT+ 4th cumulant kurtosis kappa_4 and operator trace series), and Contribution C (connected Borromean QED hbar_q^4..hbar_q^8 series, Form-B Bring-Schwinger two-photon scale alpha_EM(q_2t)^2*hbar_q^4 = 0.9752*u^4, and N>=5 truncation bound < 1e-4 sigma_exp(m_n)). Zero CODATA fitting; zero float64.
